# Install VexelRay

Desktop applications built on the VexelRay stack: a file explorer, a text editor, an image viewer, a terminal, a calculator, and fluid and rigid-body simulations. They are separate programs that know about each other, so a file in the explorer opens in the editor or the viewer, and the editor can show a file in the explorer.

## Windows

Open **PowerShell** (a normal window - administrator rights are not needed) and run:

```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sibarum/vexelray-dist/main/install.ps1 | iex
```

That installs every application below, for your user only. Each one is a separate install with its own
folder, its own entry in **Settings > Apps**, and its own updater and uninstaller, so you can remove one
and keep the others. Running the same line again updates each of them to its latest version.

| Application | What it is | Id | Installed to |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Vexplore](https://github.com/sibarum/vexelray-framework/blob/main/docs/apps/vexplore.md) | A file explorer that suggests instead of asking. | `vexplore` | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Vexplore` |
| [Vex](https://github.com/sibarum/vexelray-framework/blob/main/docs/apps/text-editor.md) | A tabbed text editor with a file navigator, on the VexelRay stack. | `text-editor` | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Vex` |
| [Pix](https://github.com/sibarum/vexelray-framework/blob/main/docs/apps/pix.md) | An image viewer: one picture, as large as the window allows, and the rest of its folder a key press away. | `pix` | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Pix` |
| [MainFrame](https://github.com/sibarum/vexelray-framework/blob/main/docs/apps/mainframe.md) | A terminal window that wraps the native Windows shell over ConPTY, built on the VexelRay stack. | `mainframe` | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\MainFrame` |
| [Calculator](https://github.com/sibarum/vexelray-framework/blob/main/docs/apps/calculator.md) | A small calculator window onto cott-engine. | `calculator` | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Calculator` |
| [Fluid Sim](https://github.com/sibarum/vexelray-sim-fluid) | Fluid simulation experiments on the VexelRay stack: dam breaks, mixing, heat and a 3D dam break, live on the GPU. | `fluid-sim` | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Fluid Sim` |
| [Rigid Sim](https://github.com/sibarum/vexelray-sim-rigid) | Rigid-body simulation experiments on the VexelRay stack: spheres that collide, bounce, spin and roll, live on the GPU. | `rigid-sim` | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Rigid Sim` |

Each application is installed by its own installer, the same one its own install command runs. This
script downloads that installer, checks it against the SHA-256 in the application's published manifest,
and runs it. The installer then checks every file it downloads in the same way. An application that has
not been published yet is skipped and reported.

### Only some of them

Set `INSTALL_ONLY` in the same PowerShell window *before* the install command:

```powershell
$env:INSTALL_ONLY = 'vexplore,text-editor'
```

### Options

These are passed on to every application's installer:

| Variable | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| `$env:INSTALL_NO_SHORTCUTS = '1'` | skip the desktop / Start menu shortcuts |
| `$env:INSTALL_NO_PATH = '1'` | do not add anything to your user PATH |
| `$env:INSTALL_NO_ASSOCIATIONS = '1'` | do not register any application to open file types |
| `$env:INSTALL_FORCE = '1'` | reinstall even where the latest version is already installed |

A particular version or folder applies to one application, so this script ignores `INSTALL_VERSION` and
`INSTALL_DIR`. To use them, run that application's own installer.

### Update

Run the install command again, or update one application from its folder:

```powershell
& "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\Vexplore\update.cmd"
```

### Uninstall

Use **Settings > Apps**, where each application has its own entry, or run the uninstaller in any of their
folders:

```powershell
& "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\Vexplore\uninstall.cmd" -Id vexplore
```

`-List` shows every install it knows about. Each application's install record is in `%LOCALAPPDATA%\vexelray-installer\installs`,
which is also how the applications find and start each other.

### Is it safe to run a script from the internet?

Read it first - it is one file: [`install.ps1`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sibarum/vexelray-dist/main/install.ps1). It runs only installers whose SHA-256
matches their application's manifest, and those installers accept a download only when its SHA-256
matches too.

macOS and Linux installers are planned.
